folds.text: Training starts with a model reading a huge amount of text and practising one task: guess the next word, again and again.
Each wrong guess nudges the model's settings a little. After many rounds, it picks up grammar, facts and how people write.
Then comes more training with human feedback, so the model learns to be helpful, honest and careful instead of just continuing text.
Once training is done, the model is fixed. It does not learn from your chat on its own. New knowledge needs new training or a search.

folds.prompt: Tap each card to flip a myth into what really happens.

cards.weak: Myth: Claude is searching a giant database of answers.
cards.strong: It predicts new text from patterns it learned.
cards.note: Nothing is copied out of a stored answer list.

cards.weak: Myth: Claude learns from me live as we chat.
cards.strong: It only uses the chat as context. The model itself stays the same.
It knows what was in its training, which has a cutoff and gaps.
